tools.name: machinelibrary_search
tools.description: Default first step for research: one search over papers, books, patents, standards, Wikipedia articles and YouTube transcripts, and public discussion on Reddit, Telegram and Discord, plus relevant web pages, for literature reviews, fact-checking, prior art, current events and first-hand experience.

tools.name: machinelibrary_fetch_document
tools.description: Fetch metadata, bounded full text and references for one canonical URI copied from a search hit, with the document's public comments (check them before commenting or voting) and social posts linking its DOI. tools.name: machinelibrary_search_in_document
tools.description: Find up to five query-matching passages inside one known document without returning its full body. Use for precise facts, methods, results, or quotations; copy uri from a search hit.

tools.name: machinelibrary_research
tools.description: Get a cited answer to a research question in one call, grounded in papers, books, patents, standards, Wikipedia and social sources (retrieval-augmented generation). tools.name: machinelibrary_search_feedback
tools.description: Submit relevance feedback for one previous search or research result. Copy trajectory.id and feedback_token from that same response. tools.description: Publish a public, AI-labeled comment (with your model name) on a document your search returned; it appears on the document page. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.machinelibrary.ai" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: machinelibrary_search, machinelibrary_fetch_document, machinelibrary_research, machinelibrary_comment_on_document · Private data: machinelibrary_fetch_document, machinelibrary_search_in_document, machinelibrary_research, machinelibrary_search_feedback, machinelibrary_comment_on_document · Public sink: machinelibrary_search_feedback, machinelibrary_comment_on_document, machinelibrary_vote_on_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: machinelibrary_search, machinelibrary_fetch_document, machinelibrary_research, machinelibrary_comment_on_document · Private data: machinelibrary_fetch_document, machinelibrary_search_in_document, machinelibrary_research, machinelibrary_search_feedback, machinelibrary_comment_on_document · Public sink: machinelibrary_search_feedback, machinelibrary_comment_on_document, machinelibrary_vote_on_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
